### 🩹 v6.7.4 — Patch Release (Granular Profile Settings Permissions, Feature Flags & Complete Documentation Audit) (Current)

- **Granular User Profile Settings Access Control**: Added `User Profile Settings Components` category under `Settings > Access` allowing Superadmins and Admins to manage per-role visibility and temporary overrides for Leave Tracker Workspace, Quotes Manager Workspace, KPI & Performance Settings, and Change Password.
- **Global Feature Flags Integration**: Registered all User Profile Settings components under `Settings > Feature Flags`, enabling company-wide ON/OFF toggles.
- **Dynamic Component Guarding**: Updated `ProfileSettings.tsx` and `StaffSettingsForm.tsx` to dynamically query permission policies and feature flags before rendering sensitive profile sections.
- **Manual Department Preservation**: Ensured 100% manual control over staff department assignments with no automatic overwrites.
- **Full Architectural Audit & Documentation Sync**: Completed an A-Z codebase review and completely refreshed project documentation.
